Appendix chapters are listed under `appendices:` in `_quarto.yml`. They are
lettered rather than numbered, so tables and figures in this one are
numbered A.1, A.2 and so on. The code that makes @tbl-descriptives is hidden
with `#| echo: false`, as it usually would be in a thesis.
